kind: pre-registered ablation (FRETISH), two arms of one binary, with a score phase and a calibration; a re-run of 2026-09-29-fretish-ablation at a later engine
kind_note: Sweep O, ordered_fields = directed against uniform, over 20 FRETISH subjects at 30 seeds, design unchanged from 2026-09-29-fretish-ablation. The calibration declaration 2026-10-06-fretish-rerun-calib (seed 0 on av1) is folded in as campaign-calib.toml.
question: The ablation's question again at a binary carrying 5dc3472 (X(m) in start_of_mode), #205 (split condition/response screen), #206 (MRS whole-spec screen) and dc13ed2 (keyword_similarity defaults to semantic). Its rows replace the ablation's in the paper's FRETISH research question. (PLAN.md, Question.)
endpoint: As the ablation, word for word. Primary: found at the cap, anytime, McNemar exact two-sided at alpha 0.05 over the 600 (subject, seed) pairs. Secondary: found at 10 s and at 100 s under the same test; paired wall time by the Wilcoxon signed-rank test on pairs where both arms finished. implies_ideal descriptive on 6 subjects. (PLAN.md, Endpoints and tests.)
decision_rule: Directed wins if McNemar's p < 0.05 and more discordant pairs favour directed. Uniform wins under the symmetric condition. Any other outcome is null. (PLAN.md.)
decision_rule_firing: Uniform wins. At the cap the directed arm holds a repair on 552 of 600 runs and the uniform arm on 572; no discordant pair favours directed and 20 favour uniform, exact McNemar p = 1.91e-06. 18 of the 20 are rad-core-10 and 2 are fsm-lmcps. The other 18 subjects tie.

arms.shared: selection nsga2-apportion, status grading mrs, weights 0.1/0.2/0.7, log metric, weakening off, termination individuals at 1000, population 100, generations 500 (ceiling), parallel 1, gen_configs.py --pin-vintage (writes keyword_similarity = semantic and semantic_trace_weight = 0.5 into every config), 7200 s runner cap, no max_wall_s

corpus: The ablation's 20 subjects: 8 whole specs (takeoff, fsm, fsm-timing, fsm-combined, fsm-lmcps, liquid-mixer, mode-arbiter, valu3s-uc6) and 12 unrealisable cores (rad-core-1-18, -10, -12-18, -17-18, -33, -45, -55, -61, -65, -68; lpc-mini-core1; lpc-full-core1). 20 x 2 arms x 30 seeds = 1200 runs.

calibration.gate: Unenforced, as PLAN.md records under Deviation: av2 and av3 started the main search before the calibration finished, so its three checks are post-hoc reads made at the close.
calibration.cost_check: Pass. Per-subject search cost against the ablation archive (results-fretish-ablation.csv, 1200 rows) is 0.36-1.05x; no subject exceeds the 2x re-plan threshold. Total 208.11 run-hours against 212.47. The two subjects that fell most are rad-core-33 (0.36x) and rad-core-61 (0.38x).
calibration.toolchain_check: Pass, with a qualification. Comparing av1's 40 calibration runs with av3's seed-0 runs of the same cells, ignoring wall-clock fields (run.log time columns, accumulated/index.tsv elapsed_s, run.json): 33 of 40 are identical in repairs, accumulated set and generation lines. The 7 that differ are lpc-full-core1 (both arms, stopped by the cap), liquid-mixer and lpc-mini-core1 (both arms) and valu3s-uc6 uniform. Each of those runs had tool calls time out (ltlfilt implication queries at the 10 s budget: e.g. liquid-mixer directed 781 on av1 against 875 on av3), and every run with no timeouts on either host is byte-identical. The divergence follows the wall clock, not the compiler.
calibration.change_check: Not run as a seed-0 diff. The registered analysis below gives the change against the archive at corpus level: the decision and its locus (rad-core-10) are unchanged.

cost.note: parallel = 1 throughout, so the sum of run wall times is the search's core-hours to a close approximation. lpc-full-core1 is 120 h of it, all 60 runs killed at 7200 s, as in the archive.

registered_primary.endpoint: found at the cap (7200 s), anytime, from the curves' time_to_first_repair

paired_wall_time.method: Wilcoxon signed-rank, normal approximation with tie and continuity corrections, as the paper's tables.py computes it above 300 pairs

secondaries.note: The secondaries carry no decision. rad-core-10's directed runs finish faster on 30 of 30 pairs, partly by ending without a repair.

config_vintage: dc13ed2 moves fitness.keyword_similarity's default from syntactic to semantic. --pin-vintage writes it into every config here, so these configs read the same whichever default a later binary carries.
out_of_scope: Steps 4 (pooled strength) and 5 (fingerprints and ball radii) of PLAN.md are analyses of these rows, run outside campaign.py; their outputs are recorded where they ran, not in this archive.
